acceptance_tests: Run ERC and confirm 0 errors and 0 warnings (baseline 10/8).
Run DRC and confirm 0 errors and 0 warnings (baseline 5/13).
Verify netlist has no unconnected pins and no single-pin nets, including VBUS.
Verify SDA and SCL nets exist, each with exactly two device pins plus 4.7 kOhm pull-ups to 3.3 V.
Verify U2.1 is on +3V3, U2.2 is on GND, and ADD0 is strapped to a defined level.
Verify J1 is a USB-C receptacle footprint with CC1/CC2 5.1 kOhm pull-downs and edge-flush placement.
Verify a 5 V to 3.3 V regulator is present and rated for at least 600 mA with 100 nF per supply pin and 10 uF bulk capacitors.
Verify board outline is within 110 x 65 mm and confirm the reduction toward the 60 x 40 mm target.
Verify a continuous bottom-layer GND plane with no split under the USB differential pair and that the pair is length-matched within 5 mm.
Verify the ESP32 antenna keepout is copper-free over at least 15 x 15 mm and U2 is at least 10 mm from the module and regulator.
Verify design rules meet 0.2 mm trace/clearance and 0.3 mm drill minimums and that gerber, drill, BOM, and placement outputs generate cleanly.
constraints: Manufacturer profile generic_two_layer: 2 layers, 0.2 mm min trace/clearance, 0.3 mm min drill, standard FR4 1.6 mm only.
J1 is currently Connector:USB_B_Micro but the request specifies USB-C; the connector must be changed and CC pull-downs added.
No voltage regulator exists between VBUS and +3V3; the +3V3 net has no driving source (VBUS is a single-pin net).
I2C nets SDA and SCL are entirely missing from the netlist; U1.GPIO21/GPIO22 and U2.SDA/SCL are unconnected.
U2 power connections are wrong: U2.5 (ADD0) sits on the GND net while U2.1 (VCC) and U2.2 (GND) are unconnected.
No decoupling or bulk capacitors are present anywhere in the design.
U1.EN is tied directly to +3V3 instead of an RC reset network.
Two PWR_FLAG symbols exist but power nets still fail ERC; flag assignment must be corrected rather than duplicated.
Board is 110 x 65 mm, which is oversized for the stated 'small' board goal.
Requirements stage is advisory only: propose changes, do not modify the project; return to project_manager.

power.input: USB-C VBUS, 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), single source; 3.3 V rail derived via an on-board regulator that does not yet exist in the design

requirements.statement: The board shall be powered from a single USB-C receptacle supplying VBUS at 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V).

requirements.source: pin table: VBUS net has only J1.1; +3V3 has no source
requirements.statement: A regulator shall convert VBUS 5 V to the 3.3 V logic rail; the current design has no regulator between VBUS and +3V3 and shall add one.
The 3.3 V rail shall supply at least 600 mA continuous to cover ESP32-WROOM-32 Wi-Fi transmit peaks plus sensor load.
Total board input current from VBUS shall not exceed 500 mA so the design remains within USB default power limits.

requirements.source: standard decoupling practice; none present in netlist
requirements.statement: Each supply pin of U1 and U2 shall have local decoupling: 100 nF per pin plus a 10 uF bulk capacitor on the 3.3 V rail and 10 uF on VBUS.
3.3 V rail ripple shall remain below 50 mV peak-to-peak under maximum load.

requirements.source: pin table: #FLG01, #FLG02 present; ERC baseline 10 errors
requirements.statement: Exactly one PWR_FLAG shall be attached per power net (+3V3, GND, VBUS) to resolve unconnected-power-source ERC errors; duplicate or misplaced flags shall be removed.
One I2C bus at 3.3 V logic shall connect U1.GPIO21 to U2.SDA and U1.GPIO22 to U2.SCL; both nets are currently absent from the netlist and shall be created.
The I2C bus shall have 4.7 kOhm pull-up resistors on SDA and SCL to the 3.3 V rail and shall operate at 100 kHz standard mode.
Exactly one I2C target device (U2, TMP102) shall be on the bus with its address strapped deterministically via ADD0 tied to GND or 3.3 V through a resistor.
U2 power pins shall be wired correctly: U2.VCC to +3V3 and U2.GND to GND; currently U2.5 (ADD0) is on the GND net and U2.1/U2.2 are unconnected.

requirements.source: request vs pin table J1 = USB_B_Micro
requirements.statement: The USB connector shall be a USB-C receptacle with CC1/CC2 5.1 kOhm pull-down resistors; J1 is currently Connector:USB_B_Micro and shall be replaced.
USB data pair D+/D- shall route as a 90 Ohm differential pair, length-matched within 5 mm, from J1 to the USB endpoint.

requirements.source: netlist +3V3: U1.1, U1.8; ESP32 reset practice
requirements.statement: U1.EN shall be pulled up to 3.3 V through 10 kOhm with a 100 nF capacitor to GND rather than tied directly to +3V3 as it is today.
Board outline shall not exceed 110 x 65 mm; the target for a 'small' board is a reduction to 60 x 40 mm or smaller.
The PCB shall be a 2-layer FR4 stackup, 1.6 mm thick, matching the generic_two_layer manufacturer profile.
The USB-C receptacle shall be placed on a board edge with its mating face flush to the outline and 3 mm keepout around the connector.
The ESP32-WROOM-32 antenna keepout shall extend past the board edge or over a copper-free area of at least 15 x 15 mm.
Minimum trace width and clearance shall be 0.2 mm for signals; the 3.3 V and VBUS power traces shall be at least 0.5 mm.
Minimum via shall be 0.6 mm pad with 0.3 mm drill.
The bottom layer shall carry a continuous GND plane with stitching vias; no split under the USB differential pair.
All components shall be single-sided (top) surface-mount where possible to keep assembly to one reflow pass.
Silkscreen shall show reference designators for all components with no silkscreen over exposed pads.

requirements.source: derived target for small hobby-class board
requirements.statement: Bill of materials cost shall not exceed 25 USD per board at quantity 10.
Bare board fabrication shall use only standard two-layer capabilities with no controlled impedance, blind vias, or extra cost options.

requirements.source: commercial range; TMP102 and ESP32 both cover it
requirements.statement: The board shall operate over 0 to 70 degC ambient.
Temperature measurement accuracy shall be within +/-0.5 degC over 0 to 65 degC as reported by the I2C sensor.
U2 shall be placed at least 10 mm from the ESP32 module and the regulator, thermally isolated with minimal copper connection, to limit self-heating error.
ERC shall report 0 errors and 0 warnings, down from the baseline of 10 errors and 8 warnings.
DRC shall report 0 errors and 0 warnings, down from the baseline of 5 errors and 13 warnings.
Netlist review shall confirm 0 unconnected pins and 0 single-pin nets; VBUS currently has one pin only.
Continuity check shall confirm the I2C nets SDA and SCL each connect exactly two pins with pull-ups present.
Manufacturability review shall confirm the design passes the generic_two_layer profile rules and that fabrication outputs (gerbers, drill, BOM, placement) generate without errors.
